C0749.title: Tangshan Bank APP Flagged for Mandatory, Frequent, and Excessive Permission Requests
C0749.summary: On December 11, 2024, the Hebei Provincial Communications Administration reported that version 1.0.6 of Tangshan Bank's "Tanghang Enterprise Banking" app on Huawei AppGallery was on the overdue rectification list for mandatory, frequent, and excessive permission requests. The notice required the company to complete rectification by December 19, 2024, or face possible removal, shutdown, or administrative penalties.

references.title: Hebei Communications Administration Notice on Apps Infringing User Rights
